sloka: तस्मात्तद्बाणपातेन अपः कुक्षिष्वशोषयत् ।विख्यातम् त्रिषु लोकेषु मधुकान्तारमेव च ॥६-२२-३९॥।।
transliteration: tasmāttadbāṇapātena apaḥ kukṣiṣvaśoṣayat ।vikhyātam triṣu lokeṣu madhukāntārameva ca ॥6-22-39॥।।

translations.english: Marukantaram is famous in the three worlds. Dasaratha's Rama, who is learned and has the valour of gods made the cavities dry and gave a boon.
